descriptions.payments:
The role
Join our Payments Engineering team to build Python APIs that settle card transactions and reconcile ledger balances. Design distributed payment services using Django, PostgreSQL and Redis. Implement idempotent transaction processing, audit trails, fraud controls and reconciliation workflows. Maintain Kafka event streams and asynchronous workers, investigate production incidents and improve observability with Prometheus dashboards. Deploy container workloads using Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS. Write unit tests, integration tests and database migration checks. Collaborate with product analysts, compliance specialists and security reviewers to deliver reliable payment infrastructure. You should understand SQL query plans, transaction isolation, retry semantics, access controls, HTTP interfaces and resilient systems. We need practical Python programming, distributed debugging and clear technical documentation.
